Title: Public Preview: Azure Virtual Network Manager high-scale private endpoints in connected groups

Body.Content:
Azure Virtual Network Manager high-scale private endpoints in connected groups is now in public preview, delivering enhanced scalability for complex Azure network environments. 

As organizations grow, the need to support large numbers of private endpoints becomes critical. This new capability enables up to 20,000 private endpoints within a connected group—empowering you to scale workloads more efficiently in Azure. When this feature is not enabled, users can have 2,000 private endpoints in a connected group.  

To get started, please refer to the documentation for guidance on enabling this preview feature.
